name: Kiwi 商家运营
description: 注册并发布 Kiwi 目录公开资料（草稿、公开预览、确认发布、撤回），让采购专家与买家按商品词找到你；绑定自有 Kiwi Merchant 服务后，还可查看商品与库存、跟进买家询价与人工队列、生成待批准的经营变更候选。
description_zh: 注册并发布 Kiwi 目录公开资料（草稿、公开预览、确认发布、撤回），让采购专家与买家按商品词找到你；绑定自有 Kiwi Merchant 服务后，还可查看商品与库存、跟进买家询价与人工队列、生成待批准的经营变更候选。
description_en: Register and publish your Kiwi catalog profile (draft, public preview, confirm-publish, withdraw) so buyers and the sourcing expert can find you by product; after connecting your own Kiwi Merchant service, also browse products and inventory, follow buyer inquiries and the human queue, and prepare merchant changes for your approval.
examples_zh: 我是新商家，怎么把商品发布到 Kiwi 目录让采购专家搜到？
帮我起草一条公开资料草稿，我要先在门户确认再发布
我的资料现在是什么状态？有没有被撤回？
examples_en: I'm a new merchant — how do I publish my products to the Kiwi catalog so the sourcing expert can find me?
Draft a catalog profile for me; I'll confirm and publish it in the portal
What's the current status of my catalog profile? Was anything withdrawn?
